lede: Khoi paper · กระดาษข่อย accounts for 56 catalogued manuscripts, 10 of them flagged research-priority. It clusters in Chiang Rai (14% of the corpus for this material), ahead of Mae Hong Son and Nan. Nearly all (68%) are written in Tham Lanna · อักษรธรรมล้านนา script. Dated witnesses run 1838–2001 CE (30 of 56 carry a date).

findings.title: The 56 khoi manuscripts
findings.gloss: Only 56 manuscripts in the collection are written on khoi; the overwhelming majority are palm-leaf.
